description: en-GB display strings. `now` is the fixed current instant (affects year suffixes and Today/Tomorrow/Yesterday). formatTime's 12h strings come from Intl en-US with 2-digit hours ("02:00 AM"); the separator before AM/PM is whatever Node's ICU emits (a plain space here; newer ICU/WebKit builds may emit U+202F). formatWallclockTime always uses a plain space and an unpadded hour.
